items.title: Ice cream vans live on the map
items.benefit: Watch a van come down your road, with its own picture, and see which vans are on the move.

items.title: Every ice cream van and shop near you
items.benefit: Ice cream businesses from open data are on the map too, with Chimes businesses in colour.

items.title: What a vendor sells
items.benefit: Tap a van or shop to see what it sells and how to contact it.

items.title: Choose what the map shows
items.benefit: Show all vendors, only Chimes vendors, only live vans, or just your favourites.

items.title: Vans across the whole map
items.benefit: Vendors choose to be seen only in customers' alert areas or everywhere on the map; an Offline van shows faded at its area.

items.title: Find ice cream by town or postcode
items.benefit: Type a town or postcode to look around anywhere, and jump back to where you are with one tap.

items.title: A quick tour of the map
items.benefit: First time in Chimes? A short tour shows you round, and tips help if you get stuck.

items.title: Find a vendor by name
items.benefit: Heard of a van or shop? Search for it by name from the map.

items.title: Chimes on the web
items.benefit: See the Chimes map in a web browser, no app needed.

items.title: Beyond ice cream
items.benefit: Food trucks and pop-up vendors, with customers choosing the food they want.

items.title: Alerts when a van comes into your area
items.benefit: Pick your area by postcode and radius, and hear the Chimes tune when a van arrives, even with the app closed.

items.title: Your postcode from where you stand
items.benefit: Fill in your alert area's postcode with one tap from your current location, and see yourself on the map.

items.title: Clear signs when alerts or location are off
items.benefit: The map shows when notifications or location are switched off, with Settings one tap away.

items.title: Richer Android alerts
items.benefit: Android alerts show the Chimes logo and a picture.

items.title: Miles or kilometres
items.benefit: Set your alert area's radius in the unit you think in.

items.title: Your vendor's own tune
items.benefit: Hear a van's own chime on its arrival alert, so you know whose van it is before you look.

items.title: Favourite vendors
items.benefit: Heart the vendors you like, see at a glance which are out now, and jump to them on the map.

items.title: Messages from your favourite vendors
items.benefit: Vendors tell the customers who favourited them that they are out today, at an event, or running an offer; mute any vendor.

items.title: WhatsApp Channels
items.benefit: Follow Chimes, and vendors who link their own Channel, on WhatsApp.

items.title: Optional customer accounts
items.benefit: Sign in if you want to, and keep your favourites and alert settings when you change phone.

items.title: Posts and photos from vendors
items.benefit: Vendors share short updates with a photo with the customers who follow them.

items.title: Chimes Cones rewards
items.benefit: Earn cones for using Chimes and swap them for treats.

items.title: Free listings for ice cream businesses
items.benefit: Put your business on the Chimes map for free, with your name, town and links, in minutes.

items.title: Live van tracking, with a free demo
items.benefit: Register your van, sign in with an emailed code, and start in demo mode before going fully live.

items.title: Claim your listing
items.benefit: Already on the map from open data? Claim the pin and put your own details on it.

items.title: Schedules and areas covered
items.benefit: Show customers the areas you cover, your weekly times and this week's changes, so they know when to expect you.

items.title: Regular routes
items.benefit: Chimes learns a van's regular rounds, if the vendor agrees, and tells customers when it usually comes near them.

items.title: A photo of your van
items.benefit: Add a photo of your van to your listing, so customers know what to look out for.

items.title: Menus
items.benefit: Add photos of your menu board, and customers see them from your card.

items.title: Several vans, one account
items.benefit: Run all your vans under one account, each on the map with its own position.

items.title: Free listings on Android
items.benefit: Register your business and manage your free listing from an Android phone.

items.title: Live van sharing on Android
items.benefit: Share your van's location from an Android phone, as you can on iPhone.

items.title: Register your interest online
items.benefit: Not ready to sign up? Leave your email on chimesapp.com and we will be in touch.

items.title: Register your interest in the app
items.benefit: Leave your details from the app's Register your business screen instead of signing up straight away.

items.title: GPS trackers
items.benefit: A tracker fitted in your van shares its position, so your phone does not have to.

items.title: Smarter planning
items.benefit: See where Chimes customers are around you on a heatmap, and plan your rounds around them.

items.title: Order ahead
items.benefit: Customers order and pay in the app, and chat with a vendor.

items.title: Live or Offline, one tap
items.benefit: Always know whether customers can see your van, and start or stop sharing with one tap.

items.title: Share location with your phone locked
items.benefit: Keep your iPhone locked in the cab and customers still see where your van is.

items.title: Hidden at home, automatically
items.benefit: Set your home area once; your van goes Offline when you park there and Live again when you leave.

items.title: Go Offline at a set time
items.benefit: Forget to stop sharing? Chimes takes you Offline at the time you choose, on the days you choose.

items.title: Face ID, Apple and Google sign-in
items.benefit: Open Chimes with Face ID, or sign in with your Apple or Google account, instead of waiting for an emailed code.

items.title: More privacy choices
items.benefit: Show customers an approximate position, or only that you are in the area.

items.title: No account needed
items.benefit: Open Chimes and it works. No sign-up, no password.

items.title: iPhone, iPad and Android
items.benefit: Chimes runs on iPhone, iPad and Android phones.

items.title: Quick Start guide
items.benefit: A short guide the first time you open Chimes, and again from Settings whenever you need it.

items.title: Delete your account
items.benefit: Delete your Chimes account yourself, at any time, from the Account screen.

items.title: Share, follow and contact us
items.benefit: Share Chimes with friends, follow us on Facebook and Instagram, and message the team from the app.

items.title: Update reminders
items.benefit: Chimes tells you when a newer version is ready, so you always have the latest fixes.
